reviews.title: Awesome cooler
reviews.comment: One of the best big block coolers you can get. I actually prefer this over AIOs fairly quiet great fan speed fairly easy to install works with amd and Intel used it for both so it’s great compatibly. And definitely bang for your buck.
reviews.author: Aren M.

reviews.title: Keeping it cool
reviews.comment: Works flawless, keeps the i9 14900k nice and cool. Not loud at all.
reviews.author: P.R

reviews.title: Great cooling, easy to install.
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C1gsQbrms1L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51NfffEEE7L._SY256.jpg Fantastic cooler!  I use a 265K with 200s boost and see idle temps 32-34c, under a full load I have seen 73c.  This cooler has impressed me with ease of installation, and just how well it works.  The screen is a nice touch, even if it is a bit basic, it def works for what I need it do though.
I run this in a Lian Li Lancool 207 so your milage may vary of course, I added 3 more low speed Noctua fans to help out temps and couldn't be happier with the result.
